name: ImageGallery
description: A grid of images that opens a lightbox: a dark dialog with the image, a counter and caption, previous and next buttons, thumbnails and arrow keys that follow the text direction. Replaces the 2.x PhotoSwipe integration.

livewire.name: image-gallery
capabilities: wire:model binds the lightbox's open state both ways through $wire.entangle()
Images also accept the 2.x url key for src, and plain URL strings

props.name: images
props.description: The images, in order: { src, alt, caption }. alt describes the image; caption is visible text under it.
props.a11y: Every image needs alt text that describes it. A caption doesn't replace it.

props.name: columns
props.description: How many columns the grid has. Emitted as --apui-_image-gallery-columns.

props.name: featured
props.description: The first image spans two columns and two rows. Emitted as data-featured.

props.name: lightbox
props.description: Each image is a button that opens the lightbox. Off renders a plain grid of figures.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the lightbox is open. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model:open. Emitted as data-state on the lightbox's parts.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The initial state of an uncontrolled lightbox.

props.name: index
props.description: The image the lightbox shows, 0-based. Pair it with index-change to control it.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: The initial image of an uncontrolled lightbox.

props.name: downloadable
props.description: Adds a download link for the image shown to the lightbox's bar.

props.name: modal
props.description: Traps focus in the lightbox, locks scroll and hides the rest of the page from assistive technology.

props.name: portal
props.description: Renders the lightbox at the end of the body (x-teleport, a React portal, Vue Teleport). Off renders it in place.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The lightbox's close button. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Close' ).
props.a11y: The close button is icon-only, so this is its only name.

props.name: previousLabel
props.a11y: The button is icon-only, so this is its only name.

props.name: nextLabel
props.a11y: The button is icon-only, so this is its only name.

props.name: counterLabel
props.description: The counter before the caption in the lightbox's title. {index} and {count} are replaced; Livewire's __() string uses :index and :count.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { grid: '…', content: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: Holds the grid and the lightbox.

parts.name: grid
parts.description: The grid of figures, in columns columns.

parts.name: item
parts.description: One image and its caption. The featured item spans two columns and rows.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: The button over an image that opens the lightbox on it, named by the image's alt text. Not rendered without lightbox.

parts.name: image
parts.description: An image: lazy-loaded in the grid, contained in the lightbox's stage.

parts.name: caption
parts.description: The caption, over the image's foot. It shows on hover and focus, and always where there's no hover.

parts.name: positioner
parts.description: Fills the viewport and centers the lightbox.

parts.name: content
parts.description: The lightbox: a dialog panel with the .apui-lightbox class. The spec calls it lightbox; it keeps Zag's name (D-019).

parts.name: bar
parts.description: The lightbox's top row: title, download and close.

parts.name: title
parts.description: The counter and caption ("3 / 6 · Evening, west façade"): the dialog's name, announced as it changes.

parts.name: download
parts.description: A download link for the image shown, with downloadable.

parts.name: closeTrigger
parts.description: The close button: a ghost, neutral, small icon-only Button.

parts.name: stage
parts.description: The image shown, with the previous and next buttons over it.

parts.name: prevTrigger
parts.description: Shows the previous image, wrapping: a soft, neutral icon-only Button. The spec's nav (prev).

parts.name: nextTrigger
parts.description: Shows the next image, wrapping. The spec's nav (next).

parts.name: thumbs
parts.description: The strip of thumbnails under the stage.

parts.name: thumb
parts.description: A thumbnail that shows its image; aria-current marks the one shown.

slots.name: caption
slots.description: Rich caption content for an image, by index (Livewire: a caption key in images).

events.name: open-change
events.description: The lightbox opened or closed itself: an image, Escape, the backdrop or the close button. Setting open doesn't fire it.

events.name: index-change
events.description: The lightbox showed another image: an image, the arrow keys, the previous and next buttons or a thumbnail. Setting index doesn't fire it.

keyboard.action: On an image, opens the lightbox on it.
In the lightbox: show the next or previous image, wrapping. They follow the text direction, so in RTL ArrowLeft shows the next image.
In the lightbox: show the first or last image.
Closes the lightbox and returns focus to the image that opened it.
Move between the lightbox's buttons; focus stays in it while it's modal.

requirements: Every image has alt text; a grid image's button is named by it, and the lightbox shows the same alt.
The lightbox is a dialog named by its title, the counter and caption, which is announced as it changes.
Focus moves into the lightbox on open, is trapped there while it's modal, and returns to the image that opened it.
The previous, next, close and download buttons have accessible names (translatable).
The thumbnail shown carries aria-current and a ring, not opacity alone.
Captions are text, never baked into images, and stay readable over the image's foot.
Arrow keys follow the text direction; the previous and next icons mirror in RTL.
Every part keeps a stable, server-rendered id in Livewire (D-015).
